zh: IKE_SA_INIT：协商算法与 DH 的第一对消息。
IKE_AUTH：认证并建立首条 Child SA。
IKE SPI：包头前两个 8 字节连接标识。
COOKIE：回应半开 SA 泛洪的载荷。
Child SA：ESP/AH 使用的下游关联。
PRF：派生全部密钥材料的伪随机函数。
en: IKE_SA_INIT: the first request/response pair negotiating algorithms and DH.
IKE_AUTH: the pair that authenticates and creates the first Child SA.
IKE SPI: the two eight-octet connection identifiers in the header.
COOKIE: the notification used against half-open SA flooding.
Child SA: the downstream ESP/AH association.
PRF: the pseudorandom function deriving all keying material.
